restaurantName: The Tea Room at The Egerton House Hotel
bio: Visit The Tea Room at The Egerton House Hotel for a delightful Best of British Afternoon Tea.  Enjoy a selection of freshly cut sandwiches, including H. Forman and Son smoked salmon, free-range egg mayonnaise, Blythburgh roast ham & English mustard, cucumber & cream cheese, and Coronation chicken. Followed by our home-baked scones with delicious preserves and Devonshire clotted cream.  Relax in the sumptuous Tea Room with a fragrant pot of loose-leaf tea, or perhaps a glass of Champagne, and prepare to be spoiled. Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options are available (24-hours notice required).  Egerton House is a small luxury townhouse hotel in the heart of London's Knightsbridge. Just two minutes walk from Harrods, the chic shops of Brompton Road and the Victoria & Albert Museum, Egerton House is ideally situated for an intimate Afternoon Tea whilst shopping or sightseeing.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Tea Room from Wednesday to Sunday. The seating times will be at 2pm, 3pm and 4pm each day subject to availability.  Please note dogs will only be allowed on Thursdays and Sundays, and only one dog per table.  Afternoon Tea gift vouchers for Egerton House are also available to buy here .
pageTitle: The Tea Room at The Egerton House Hotel
